title: Readout Dependent Parameter Identifiability of Quantum Kernels
summary: A circuit parameter can change measured features without changing their projected Gaussian kernel. We characterize this lost dependence and distinguish recovery by metric design from nonlinear feature expansion. With analytic feature coefficients, a fixed finite data basis affinely independent on the input domain, a fixed positive definite metric, and fixed bandwidth, the coefficient Gram matrix determines all-input kernel equivalence, global coordinate inactivity, and generic differential rank.
